inputs.text: It’s a failure of public responsibility when communities must rally just to protect a shared watershed from coal exploration. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, is asking Alberta’s government to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” This is about more than one campaign: people’s water and livelihoods should not be sacrificed to industry, while the burden of resisting extraction is pushed onto those who face its risks. Government should protect the public, not leave residents to fight for basic safeguards.
